opportunities.name: GitHub candidate research → hiring lead email
opportunities.description: Look up the GitHub user {username}, record their follower count, top repo (stars, language) and latest post, then write a lead email to hiring@example.com for the role {role}.
steps: Open github.com and click the Search box
Type {username} and press Enter
Choose the 'Users' filter in the results sidebar
Open the matching user profile
Read the follower count and pinned/top repositories
Open the top repo and check its star count and language
Open the mail compose page
Enter hiring@example.com in To
Set Subject to 'Lead for {role}: {username}'
Set Body to '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {latest_post}.'
Send (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: username=karpathy, role=ML Research Engineer, 226k followers, nanoGPT 63.8k stars Python, latest post microgpt (nanoGPT repo checked again at 930.9)
username=gaearon, role=Staff Frontend Engineer, 94k followers, react/react 251k stars JavaScript, latest post 'How I Vibed a Proof of Conway's Conjecture' (react repo checked again at 1753.3)
username=simonw (research only; no email seen before the recording ended)

opportunities.name: OpenStreetMap nearest-place search and walking directions
opportunities.description: Search OpenStreetMap for the nearest {place_type} to {address}, then get walking directions from the address to the result and note the distance and time.
steps: Open openstreetmap.org
Type '{place_type} near {address}' in Search and press Enter
Pick the top Nominatim result and open its details
Click the Directions icon
Set From to {address} and To to the result's name/address
Read the distance and walking time from the Directions panel
Add a note: '{address}: nearest {place_type} {result}, {distance}, {time} walk'

instances.values: place_type=library, address=350 5th Ave, New York → 96th Street Library, 5.5 km, 74 min (interleaved with other tasks)
place_type=coffee, address=Union Square → no results found

opportunities.name: Wikipedia article lookup → one-line summary note
opportunities.description: Search Wikipedia for {topic}, read the lead sentence, and save a one-line summary to the Notes page.
steps: Open Wikipedia and close any fundraising banner
Type {topic} in Search Wikipedia and click Search or the suggestion
Read the article's lead paragraph
Open the Notes page and click New note
Type '{topic}: {short description}' and save

instances.values: topic=Midtown Manhattan → 'central Manhattan and the city's primary central business district'
topic=Satya Nadella (looked up again at 1442.3–1472.4 and 2012.5–2036.0)

opportunities.name: Wayback Machine historical snapshot → note headline
opportunities.description: Open the Wayback Machine for {domain}, choose the {year} calendar, open a snapshot, and note the site's headline from that year.
steps: Open web.archive.org
Type {domain} in the URL box and press Enter
Click {year} on the timeline
Click a date with a snapshot in the calendar
Read the main headline on the archived page
Open Notes and add '{domain} in {year}: {headline}'

instances.values: domain=microsoft.com, year=2014 → 'Meet the Nokia Lumia 1520 and Lumia 1020'
Wayback Machine opened again; domain not visible in frames
